meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 能用 iMessage 收发消息。支持本地(macOS,读本机聊天记录,需授权完全磁盘访问)或 Photon 远程服务两种方式,并把对话绑定到你指定的号码或邮箱。
howto.when: 当你说“add imessage”“connect imessage”“add photon”等,请求添加或连接 iMessage 通道时触发;也适合首次设置或用 Photon 远程接入时。

say.text: 把 iMessage 通道加进来
say.note: 开始复制适配器、注册并引导设置
需在 macOS 上授权完全磁盘访问

say.text: 通过 Photon 接入 iMessage
say.note: 引导填写服务器地址和 API 密钥

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw can send/receive iMessage. Two modes: local (macOS, reads the Mac's chat.db, needs Full Disk Access) or remote via Photon, binding chat to your number/email.
howto.when_en: Triggers on add imessage, connect imessage, add photon, etc., when adding/connecting iMessage; also first-time setup or switching to Photon remote.

say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, and guides setup
Needs Full Disk Access on macOS
Asks for server URL and API key
